title: CWP/27337/2025 of AU SMALL FINANCE BANK LTD Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHEEL NAGU, CHIEF JUSTICE
text:
113 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of decision: 28.10.2025 AU SMALL FINANCE BANK LTD. ....Petitioner Versus STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHEEL NAGU, CHIEF JUSTICE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJIV BERRY Present: Ms. Deepika Mittal, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Deepak Balyan, Addl. Advocate General, Haryana. SHEEL NAGU, C.J. (Oral)

1. The petitioner-Financial Institution is before this Court invoking writ as well as supervisory jurisdiction under Article 226/227 Constitution of India, being aggrieved by inaction on the part of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Faridabad to decide the application submitted by petitioner u/s 14 of Securitization and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002 (in short the SARFAESI Act) which is pending since 09.05.2025.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner-Financial Institution informs that the said application is now fixed before the concerned Court for 31.10.2025.

3. In view of above, present petition is hereby disposed of, with a direction to respondent-CJM, Faridabad to consider and dispose of the application u/s 14 of the Act moved by the petitioner dated 09.05.2025 (Annexure P-3) expeditiously, preferably on the date already fixed i.e. 31.10.2025, or at best, within a period of thirty (30) days thereafter. (SHEEL NAGU) CHIEF JUSTICE (SANJIV BERRY) 28.10.2025 JUDGE mohit goyal
